A '''Space Singer''' was the term given to [[Shashay]] [[Astrogation/Legends|astrogators]]. Their [[Bird/Legends|avian]] brains were able to navigate the intricacies of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] due to their in-built knowledge of three-dimensional flight. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], many Space Singers worked as astrogators aboard [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[Starship/Legends|starships]].
